author: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID)
why: Colourised TEM; caption confirms yellow fever virus particles within distended endoplasmic reticulum in infected Vero E6 cells, captured at NIAID’s Fort Detrick facility. Strong yellow-on-blue contrast and square composition suit a 9:10 crop; 3000 px download, without labels or watermark.
